notes: The terminal settings profile gains two shop-wide fields. Path shortcuts let you write a folder down once - GAMES for D:\Games - and use it in every game's paths on every terminal, so moving the games to a different disk is one row here rather than every game on every machine. And the keyboard shortcut customers press to put their countdown over a fullscreen game can now be set for the whole floor from the counter. Both need terminals on 1.3.0 or newer.
